_about: Physical photographs used by the README and site, all from Wikimedia Commons under free licenses. The site loads them from Commons at view time; scripts/fetch_images.py mirrors them into site/assets/photos/ and refreshes author/license from the Commons API (writes CREDITS.md). Where 'author' is 'see source', the fetch script fills it in.
